items.difficulty_reason: Full chain: reduce via the accepted Artin-approximation lemma to A = completed local ring of a scheme point, note the branch-map construction simplifies, translate into commutative algebra (C a G-ring by the named finite-type-over-G-ring proposition, C -> A regular), form the regular map of Artinian local rings R -> R', prove length equality via the flat length formula and m_R R' = m_R' from regularity of the zero-dimensional homomorphism. No omissions.
